messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

E come quei che con lena affannata, → そして、息切れした者のように、
uscito fuor del pelago a la riva, → 海を抜けて岸に出て、
si volge a l'acqua perigliosa e guata, → 危険な水に向き直り、見つめる、

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | **E** | Coordinating conjunction linking to previous discourse | そして | “and then” | OK | | **come** | Comparative particle introducing similarity | のように | “like / as” | OK | | **quei** | Demonstrative pronoun, masculine plural, “those” (subject) | 者 | “person / one” | OK | | **che** | Relative pronoun introducing the clause “che con lena affannata” | — (implicit) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **con** | Preposition “with” (instrumental) | — (implicit) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **lena** | Noun “breath” | 息 | “breath” | OK | | **affannata** | Adjective “spent, exhausted” (modifying *lena*) | 切れた | “exhausted / cut” (as part of “息切れした”) | OK | | **uscito** | Verb “issued, exited” | 抜けて | “exits / goes out” | OK | | **fuor** | Preposition “out of” (spatial) | — (included in 抜けて) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **del** | Preposition + article “of the” | の | “of” | OK | | **pelago** | Noun “sea” | 海 | “sea” | OK | | **a** (1st) | Preposition “to, upon” (direction toward *riva*) | に | “to / at” | OK | | **la** | Definite article (feminine singular) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **riva** | Noun “shore” | 岸 | “shore” | OK | | **si** | Reflexive pronoun (3rd person) | — (implicit in 向き直り) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **volge** | Verb “turns” (reflexive) | 向き直り | “turns (around)” | OK | | **a** (2nd) | Preposition “to” (target of the turn) | に | “to” | OK | | **l'acqua** | Noun “the water” | 水 | “water” | OK | | **perigliosa** | Adjective “perilous” | 危険な | “dangerous / perilous” | OK | | **e** | Coordinating conjunction “and” linking two verbs | 、 | “and” (realised as a comma) | OK | | **guata** | Verb “gazes” | 見つめる | “gazes / looks at” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *che, con, fuor, la, si* – Japanese does not require these grammatical particles/words; their meanings are absorbed by other elements or are implicit. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
